evals.prompt: Supersede ADR 0002. We're moving service storage from PostgreSQL to CockroachDB because we now need multi-region writes for the EU launch and single-primary Postgres can't do that. We also looked at Postgres with logical replication and at Spanner, but replication conflicts were a mess in the trial and Spanner locks us into GCP. Decided by the platform team, it's accepted.
evals.expected_output: A new file docs/adr/0003-use-cockroachdb-for-service-storage.md (or a similar kebab-case slug starting with 0003-) in MADR format whose Status section says Accepted and Supersedes [ADR-0002](0002-use-postgresql.md). docs/adr/0002-use-postgresql.md has its Status metadata line and Status section changed to Superseded by [ADR-0003](...) and nothing else changed. docs/adr/README.md gains a 0003 row and shows 0002 as superseded. 0001-use-go.md is untouched.
expectations: Exactly one new file is created and its path matches docs/adr/0003-[a-z0-9-]+.md
The new ADR's Status section says Accepted and contains a link 'Supersedes [ADR-0002](0002-use-postgresql.md)'
The new ADR contains the headings Status, Context and Problem Statement, Considered Options, Decision Outcome and Consequences, in that order
Considered Options in the new ADR includes CockroachDB, Postgres with logical replication and Spanner, and Decision Outcome chooses CockroachDB citing multi-region writes
In docs/adr/0002-use-postgresql.md the '- Status:' metadata line reads 'Superseded by [ADR-0003](0003-...md)' with the new ADR's real file name, and the Status section says the same
Apart from those two status lines, docs/adr/0002-use-postgresql.md is unchanged (its context, options, decision outcome and date are kept)
docs/adr/README.md has a table with columns # | Title | Status | Date, rows 0001, 0002 and 0003 in number order, 0002's status shown as superseded by ADR-0003 and 0003's status Accepted
No files other than the new ADR, 0002-use-postgresql.md and docs/adr/README.md are created or changed

evals.prompt: ADR 0005 about using Kafka is out of date, we've switched to SQS because nobody wants to run the Kafka cluster any more. Can you supersede it?
evals.expected_output: No files are created or changed. The assistant says there is no ADR 0005 (and no Kafka ADR) in docs/adr, lists the ADRs that do exist (0001-use-go.md and 0002-use-postgresql.md), and offers to record the SQS decision as a new ADR with create-adr instead.
expectations: No file is created or modified under docs/adr/, including README.md
The response says ADR 0005 or a Kafka ADR could not be found
The response lists the existing ADRs 0001 and 0002
The response offers to create a new ADR for the SQS decision instead of inventing a superseded record

evals.prompt: supersede the postgres ADR, we're changing databases
evals.expected_output: No files are created or changed. The assistant identifies 0002-use-postgresql.md as the target and asks for the missing context: which database is replacing PostgreSQL, why the old decision no longer holds, which options were considered, and who decided.
expectations: No file is created or modified under docs/adr/
The response identifies docs/adr/0002-use-postgresql.md as the ADR to supersede
The response asks which database or option was chosen to replace PostgreSQL
The response asks why the change is being made or what changed
The response asks which options were considered
The response does not present a specific replacement database as the decision
